outcome: Time interval from admission to delivery
cohort: 72 pregnant females aged 20-45 years with singleton pregnancies and gestational age between 28 and 37 weeks, presenting with preterm leakage of amniotic fluid.
finding: The existence of fetal membranes with increased echogenicity overriding the cervix is associated with a shorter admission-to-delivery time and higher incidence of spontaneous preterm labor, anticipating an unavoidable preterm birth.
followup_time: up to 20 days (from admission to delivery)
gest_age: 28 to 37 weeks (mean 32.47 weeks at hospital entry)
